plan: A fairy support who turns her enemies into animals and makes her allies giant.
aSurveiller: Her W (Whimsy). She turns you into an animal: you can't attack or cast spells for a moment.
contrer: Save your big spell for after her W: polymorphed, you can't do anything.
Focus on her: she makes her allies very strong.
After her R, her ally has much more health: switch targets.
forces: Turns an enemy into an animal.

sorts.P: Pix shoots along with her and her allies.
sorts.W: Polymorphs an enemy or speeds up an ally.
sorts.E: Shield for an ally or damage on an enemy.
sorts.R: Makes an ally giant and knocks up.

momentFort: Useful from the start, very strong in team fights.
